# Antigravity Usage & Speed Monitor Local usage, speed, context, and quota monitor for Google Antigravity 2.0, Antigravity IDE, and Antigravity CLI, with no external npm dependencies. [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor?style=flat-square&color=2A5E76&label=release)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/total?style=flat-square&color=0ea5e9)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor?style=flat-square&color=f59e0b)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/stargazers) [![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor?style=flat-square&color=3b82f6)](LICENSE) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0%20npm%20packages-10b981?style=flat-square)](#local-development) [![Platforms](https://img.shields.io/badge/platforms-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-6366f1?style=flat-square)](#client-support) English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [Features](#features) · [Screenshots](#screenshots) · [Client Support](#client-support) · [Installation](#installation) · [Usage](#usage) · [Development](#local-development)

[Latest Release](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest) · [Download ZIP (`usage-monitor.zip`)](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/usage-monitor.zip)
--- ## Features - **Live Metrics & Customizable Layout**: Tracks output speed (`tok/s`), time-to-first-token (`TTFT`), session average speed, step/session USD cost, cache hit rate, tightest remaining quota, and session tokens. You can choose and reorder the overview metric cards (4 shown by default out of 9 options) and section blocks. - **10-Category Context Breakdown**: Shows the token breakdown of the latest request across assistant replies, tool results, user messages, subagent notifications, checkpoints, system prompts, system tools, MCP tools, skills, and user rules, with a switcher between the main agent and spawned subagents. - **Quota Pool Tracking, Lease Reservation & Burn-Rate Reference**: Reads 5-hour and weekly quotas, reset timers, and cycle consumption across `Gemini`, `Gemini 4 Argon`, `Gemini 4 Carbon`, and `Claude & GPT` pools (plus Ultra `5x / 20x` tier badges), renders an in-flight lease reservation segment with an account-isolated per-model burn-rate & equivalent full-pool cost popover (`?`), and preserves cached quota data with a stale notice when upstream is temporarily unavailable. - **Account Sign-in and Switching on Windows**: Choose Sign in with Google under Preferences → Account. Browser authorization automatically adds the account and loads its quota. Existing refresh tokens and OAuth JSON can also be imported. Switch and restart closes and reopens the App and newer IDE sharing its sign-in. Save your work before switching. - **Main Agent, Subagents, Swarm & SSH Isolation**: Merges main agent, subagent, and Native Swarm worker steps in chronological order (or filters by individual agent), renders optional turn rails, expands running tasks inline, and isolates per-window caches and quotas across multiple SSH Remote windows (`endpointId`). - **Call Details, Timing Tooltips & Anomaly Chips**: Includes **By Step** and **By Model** tabs (with multi-model LOESS throughput/TTFT fit charts), clickable column sorting, hover TTFT/duration stage breakdowns, accent-highlighted compaction rows with diagnostic tooltips, and an optional live search & 9-category anomaly/compaction/low-cache/slow-TTFT filter toolbar. Supports 2–14 configurable columns and custom token DSL strings such as `context:in:cache`. - **Historical Usage, Project Attribution & Heatmap**: Summarizes tokens, uncached input vs. cache-read savings, thinking/output split, smooth hourly/daily trend curves (switching automatically to a GitHub-style daily calendar heatmap over `>90` days), **Model / Project (Workspace) / Session** rankings, client attribution (`Desktop App` / `IDE` / `CLI`), and monthly bar charts with pointer-following breakdown popovers across `Today`, `1d`, `7d`, `14d`, `30d`, `All`, or custom date/time ranges. - **Native `.xlsx` / Markdown Exports & Settings Backup**: Exports multi-sheet localized Excel (`.xlsx`) workbooks and Markdown summaries for both Usage Statistics and Call Details directly to `~/Downloads` with an in-app reveal toast, plus portable JSON preference backup/import. - **Cross-Client Session Migration**: Built-in opt-in session migrator (`Preferences → Other`) moves or clones conversations across `Antigravity CLI` ↔ `Desktop App / IDE` and `Legacy IDE (.db)` with isolated UUID rewriting to prevent cross-client mirror collisions or double billing. - **Multi-Client Capsules & CLI `statusLine` Modes**: Integrates as a titlebar or composer capsule (with ring quota gauges and main-agent context lock) and auxiliary sidebar in Antigravity 2.0, a titlebar/composer capsule in Antigravity IDE, a single-line 24-bit ANSI `statusLine` in Antigravity CLI (`--style pill|bar|compact`, `--preset compact|balanced|full`, `--json`), and a standalone local web UI. - **No `app.asar` Modification & Desktop 2.33.0+ Auto-Provisioning**: Titlebar/composer injection and context hooks run in memory over local CDP (`DevToolsActivePort`). Automatically provisions Desktop `2.33.0+` user shortcuts/launchers (with one-click out-of-job host relaunch) and `~/.antigravity-ide/argv.json` without touching installation binaries or `app.asar`. - **Per-Model Context Windows (Main & Subagent/Swarm)**: Sets context window limits per model series or follows host defaults, with independent toggles for the main agent (CDP request hook), spawned subagents / Swarm workers (local loopback CloudCode proxy), and CLI (`AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE`). - **Appearance, Offline Storage & Cloud Updates**: Supports `zh-CN` / `en-US` / host language, borderless Modern UI, `sm / md / lg / xl` font scaling, 6 theme accents plus host matching, offline reading from CLI SQLite + WAL, `annotations/*.pbtxt`, `transcript.jsonl`, and `.deep_stats_cache.json`, GitHub [`pricing-catalog.json`](pricing-catalog.json) sync, and in-panel release updates (`manual` / `auto` / `off`). --- ## Screenshots ### IDE & CLI

Antigravity IDE
Titlebar capsule and hover popover showing step cost, context usage, and pool quotas

Antigravity CLI (agy)
Single-line 24-bit ANSI bottom statusLine with active count, TPS, TTFT, step cost, and color-coded quota/context pill gauges
### Panel Tabs

Live Overview
TPS, TTFT, 10-category context bar, quota pools with lease reservation, and live Swarm/subagent tasks
Usage Statistics
Token totals, cache hit rate, smooth trend chart, and Model / Project / Session rankings
Call Details
Sortable main, Swarm, and subagent step rows with turn rail, compaction highlight, tokens, and cost
--- ## Client Support | Client | Status Capsule / Bar | Panel UI | Offline SQLite & Logs | Per-Model Context Limit | Modifies `app.asar` | | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | **Antigravity 2.0 (Desktop)** | Titlebar / Composer | Popover + Right Sidebar | Yes | CDP Hook + Local CloudCode Proxy | No | | **Antigravity IDE** | Titlebar / Composer | Capsule Popover | Yes | CDP Hook + Local CloudCode Proxy | No | | **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)** | Native ANSI `statusLine` | Standalone Web (`--port`) | Yes (`node:sqlite` + `.pbtxt`) | `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` | No | | **SSH Remote / Headless Linux** | Per-Endpoint Capsule / ANSI `statusLine` | SSH Overlay / `--token` Web | Yes | Per-Endpoint Hook / Env | No | > [!NOTE] > On **Antigravity Desktop 2.33.0+** and **Antigravity IDE**, enabling the plugin automatically provisions user launch shortcuts / `~/.antigravity-ide/argv.json` with `"remote-debugging-port": "0"` via a zero-tool MCP keep-alive entry (`0` context tokens). On Desktop `2.33.0+` you can click **One-Click Relaunch** directly inside the panel banner; on IDE, restart once after first activation so the titlebar capsule can attach. --- ## Installation Keep the folder name as `usage-monitor`. **No `npm install` is needed.** ### Option 1: Release ZIP Download [`usage-monitor.zip`](https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/usage-monitor.zip) and extract it into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` so the directory path is `~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor`.
Windows PowerShell command for ZIP installation ```powershell $pluginsDir = "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins" New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $pluginsDir -Force | Out-Null Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor/releases/latest/download/usage-monitor.zip" -OutFile "$env:TEMP\usage-monitor.zip" Expand-Archive -Path "$env:TEMP\usage-monitor.zip" -DestinationPath $pluginsDir -Force ```
### Option 2: Git Clone ```powershell # Windows (PowerShell) git clone --filter=blob:none --single-branch https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\usage-monitor" ``` ```bash # macOS / Linux git clone --filter=blob:none --single-branch https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor ``` Or ask Antigravity directly: ```text Clone https://github.com/yuhuan-dev/antigravity-usage-monitor with --filter=blob:none --single-branch to ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor and enable the plugin ``` --- ## Usage 1. Open **Customizations → Installed** in the left sidebar and enable `usage-monitor`. 2. **Antigravity 2.0 (Desktop)**: - Mounts a capsule in the top-right titlebar (**hover** for summary, **click** for the 4-tab popover, **right-click** to refresh), alongside the right auxiliary sidebar pane. 3. **Antigravity IDE**: - **Restart Antigravity IDE once** after enabling for the first time. Keep **Mount Mode** on **Dual-mount** and click the top-bar capsule to open the panel. 4. **Antigravity CLI (`agy`)**: - When `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli` exists, `statusLine` in `settings.json` is configured automatically (existing third-party `statusLine.command` entries are left untouched) to render a single-line ANSI bar (`● 1 active 38.1 t/s | 0.85s | ◎ 17%`). - Toggle via `/statusline` in `agy` or **Preferences → Structure → Mount & Capsule Bar**. 5. **Standalone Web Server (Headless / Remote)**: ```bash # 1. Start on the host (listens on 127.0.0.1:8787 by default) node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor/sidecars/panel/standalone.mjs --port 8787 # 2. Forward the port locally and open http://localhost:8787 ssh -L 8787:127.0.0.1:8787 user@your-server ```
Standalone CLI flags, background auto-start, and non-loopback token auth - **Auto-start with `agy`**: Set `USAGE_MONITOR_STANDALONE_PORT=8787` or `"standalonePort": 8787` in `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/sidecar_data/usage-monitor/panel/data/settings.json` to start the web UI together with the MCP sidecar supervisor. - **Non-loopback auth**: Binding to `0.0.0.0` or a LAN address requires `--token ` (or `USAGE_MONITOR_STANDALONE_TOKEN`); starting on a non-loopback address without a token is rejected. - **Overrides**: Supports `--data-dir`, `--app-data-dir`, `--gemini-dir`, `--ls-addr`, and `--csrf-token`. - **Offline fallback**: When `agy` is not running, the backend reads `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli` (`conversation_summaries.db`, `conversations/*.db`, `annotations/*.pbtxt`, and `transcript.jsonl`) and switches to live RPC once `agy` starts.
--- ## Configuration & Calculation Notes
UI options: mount mode, capsule slots, token formats, model IDs, and context limits - **Mount Mode & Width**: Switch between **Dual-mount (Top Bar + Sidebar)**, **Composer**, and **Sidebar only**. Popover width defaults to **Auto Fit** (expands within window bounds for wide tables) or a fixed width (`440–1080 px`). - **Capsule Slots**: Choose 1–5 metric slots and reorder them (default: Output Speed, TTFT, Context Usage), plus an optional toggle for the active-session indicator. - **Call Details Table & Token Format**: Toggle agent badges, turn rail (off by default), and speed color grading (off by default). Choose `Ctx / Think / Reply`, `In / Out / Cache` (with per-item USD tooltips), or custom format strings like `context:new:cache` or `in:out:cache`. - **Model Name Format**: Choose **Compact short alias** (`argon-4-high`), **Full raw ID**, or **Trimmed raw ID** (strips `gemini-` / `claude-` / `gpt-` prefixes while keeping `·compact` suffixes intact). - **Per-Model Context Limits**: Configure limits per model across thinking levels or follow host defaults under **Preferences → Other → Model Context Settings**. App/IDE applies saved rules at startup; CLI sets `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE`.
Model identification, compaction inference, and cost estimation rules - **Model Resolution**: Read from each step's raw usage payload or matching generator metadata; explicit models are never overwritten. When an automatic compaction step omits the model field, it is inferred from adjacent steps in the same conversation (checking prior steps first, then following steps, preferring the same provider) for display and estimation, or shown as unknown compaction if none exist. - **Cost Calculation**: If a model or price entry cannot be resolved, step cost is shown as pending while tokens still count toward totals; session totals sum all resolved steps. USD numbers are estimated from public per-million-token API pricing in [`pricing-catalog.json`](pricing-catalog.json) for reference only and do **not** reflect subscription quota consumption. - **Cache & Speed Averages**: Upgrading re-checks cached entries against raw trajectory data while preserving token counts and valid timings. Compaction steps display request TPS in step tables but are excluded from session speed and TTFT averages.
Updating and data directory - **In-Panel Update**: When a new GitHub release is available, a version badge appears next to the capsule and in the panel header. Update mode (`Manual` / `Auto` / `Off`) and price catalog sync can be configured under **Preferences → Other**. - **Manual Git Update**: - Windows: `git -C "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\usage-monitor" pull --ff-only` - macOS / Linux: `git -C ~/.gemini/config/plugins/usage-monitor pull --ff-only` - Toggle the plugin off and back on in **Customizations → Installed**. - **Data Persistence**: Settings and parsed caches live in `~/.gemini/antigravity/sidecar_data/usage-monitor/` (or `sidecars/panel/.data/` in standalone mode), so updates keep existing history intact.
--- ## Local Development All backend and frontend modules use pure Node.js ESM and a lightweight custom reactive component & incremental DOM patch engine (`defineComponent` + `domPatch`, with Shadow DOM isolation for host overlays) and **no external npm dependencies** (Node.js 22.5+ is recommended for built-in `node:sqlite`). ```bash cd sidecars/panel # Rebuild app.js and styles.css after modifying src/ npm run build # Run unit and integration tests npm test ``` ## Contributing & License Issues and pull requests are welcome. If you modify files under `sidecars/panel/src/`, please rebuild via `npm run build` and make sure `npm test` passes. Licensed under the [GNU General Public License v3.0](LICENSE). ## Star History

## v1.5.6 更新内容

### 新增功能
- **七语种全栈本地化**：新增繁体中文、日语、韩语、德语、法语，现共支持 7 套完整语言，覆盖监控面板、CLI 状态栏、独立浏览器页面、报表导出及 Antigravity 宿主界面语言包。
- **实时多币种消费换算（#50）**：在「控制中心 → 常规」支持选择 20 种显示货币（默认随界面语言自动切换人民币、台币、日元、韩元、欧元），免配置拉取实时汇率并在消费统计总额及拆解中同步展示。
- **本地三端会话管理及大容量迁移**：「控制中心」新增「会话」页签，集中检索、排行及批量删除三端会话（支持在线删除和离线深度清理）；「跨端迁移」上限提至 5000 条并支持分页分批。
- **macOS / Linux / WSL2 跨平台多账号切换**：多账号登录、凭证保险箱及切号能力扩展至全平台，自动适配 macOS 钥匙串、Linux 系统密钥环（无桌面密钥环时降级为口令加密）及 WSL2 宿主凭据。
- **大尺寸趋势指标卡及额度剩余显示（#55）**：实时监控和悬浮窗支持自适应宽度的大尺寸趋势卡；「控制中心 → 结构 → 实时监控布局」新增「额度显示（已用 / 剩余）」切换并联动悬浮窗。
- **开发者选项及高风险功能双层开关（#52）**：在「控制中心 → 其他 → 开发者选项」新增两级保护开关，默认隐藏「账号」页签和「模型上下文设置」入口，关闭后立即停用相关本地代理和注入。
- **Antigravity IDE Remote-SSH 远程监控**：支持自动探测并监控 Antigravity IDE 的 Remote-SSH 远程会话，同时隔离 Desktop 和 IDE 的启动参数配置及重启操作。

### 体验优化
- **结构页全画布直接拖拽排序**：挂载胶囊、悬浮窗、实时监控和调用明细预览区均支持直接拖动槽位、模块、指标卡和列头排序，列表拖拽更流畅跟手，支持按 `Esc` 取消。
- **非阻塞渐进式缓存重建**：重建历史缓存时优先立即恢复当前活跃会话及子代理，历史记录在后台分片回填并展示实时进度，不再阻塞面板操作。
- **回退对话保留历史消耗统计**：撤销对话到早期节点后，历史 Token、费用、额度和模型汇总不再回缩，并在调用明细中以灰底淡字标识已回退步骤。
- **更清爽的配置布局及排版细节**：桌面/IDE 和 CLI 挂载胶囊拆分为独立配置卡片，统一界面等宽数字排版，并精简设置说明文案、单行步骤表及配额燃速浮窗显示。

### 问题修复
- **修复宿主界面翻译误翻对话正文、公式及代码区（#54）**：完整豁免 AI 回复正文、数学公式、代码/Diff 视图、终端及常见英文小写词，避免正文内容被误译，并更新内置简体中文语言包至 `1.0.3`。
- **修复非中文环境下的残留中文及页面标题错位（#44、#49）**：非中文宿主下侧边栏标签标题、独立 Web 首屏、Token 验证页、未知配额池标签及导出报表全面跟随当前语言，不再残留硬编码中文。
- **修复无头 CLI 并发运行导致桌面顶栏胶囊误卸载（#46）**：一次性无头 CLI 调用（如 `-p` / `--print`）不再抢占桥接租约，多窗口或副进程退出时不再误卸载运行中桌面的顶栏胶囊。
- **修复混用多思考档位时模型简称锁死（#45）**：同一基础模型混用多种思考档位时，模型汇总和趋势图改为展示调用次数最多的主导简称，不再固定显示首个档位。
- **修复重启后宿主主题色丢失及侧边栏字体不同步**：缓存宿主原生主题色和字体变量，消除重启侧边栏时的短瞬闪白，并同步响应缩放比例。
- **修复家庭组 / 其他设备消耗检测过度敏感的问题**：优化配额预占及外部消耗判定逻辑，不再因本地账单落盘延迟、5h 单桶预占租约、冷启动或微小副本抖动频繁误报，且历史误报状态可自动自愈。
- **修复已删除的本地会话仍显示在最近会话列表中的问题（#39）**：本地文件和宿主摘要均消失的同账号会话会自动从顶栏会话下拉框中隐藏，同时完整保留历史用量、费用及额度统计，恢复副本后重新显示且不重复计费。
- **修复表格列宽、连接误报、登录提示及迁移时间戳问题**：修正步骤表列宽锁定和浮层宽度偏移、瞬时超时误报连接不可达、登录完成提示残留，以及空伴生文件干扰会话迁移时间的问题。

### 升级说明
- 「设置」更名为「控制中心」，原「跨端迁移」入口移至新增的「会话」页签。
- 「账号」页签和「模型上下文设置」默认收纳于「控制中心 → 其他 → 开发者选项」（默认关闭）；此前启用多账号切换或自定义上下文上限的用户，升级后需依次开启两项开关并重新确认风险提示。

Thanks to @mikessslxxx (#39), @eclectice (#44, #45, #49, #50), @ffreedomfree (#46), @Aevisen (#52), @AdenXie (#54), @SHLE1 (#55)

## 安装 / 更新

1. 下载下方 `usage-monitor.zip`。
2. 解压到 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/`，保持 `usage-monitor` 目录结构；已安装用户直接覆盖同名插件目录即可。
3. 在 **Customizations → Installed** 中重新开关插件，或重启 Antigravity。

也可直接在面板内通过版本更新功能在线升级；通过 Git 安装的用户在 `main` 分支执行 `git pull --ff-only` 后重新开启插件即可。

无需运行 `npm install`。在 Antigravity 宿主内运行时，历史缓存及设置存放于插件目录之外，覆盖安装不会清除它们。SHA-256 校验值见附件 `usage-monitor.zip.sha256`。
